prompt_en: Vertical documentary-style medium-close photograph in a warm maid-cafe interior. One explicitly adult original nekomimi maid stands behind the counter in a covered frilled uniform. Her baseline is a brisk, guarded service front. An adult customer's lightly bandaged hand has just reached toward a steaming ceramic cup. Freeze the exact instant mid-sleeving, before the protective handoff is complete: her right hand has pulled the cup just beyond the customer's fingers while her left hand is halfway sliding an open plain kraft heat sleeve around it. The half-seated sleeve, bare bandaged customer hand, and cup steam all remain visible. Her mouth tightens into a small huff and her gaze turns away, but one compact living cat ear swivels toward the customer before her face does; her fingers remain precise rather than gentle or posed. The guarded service front is contradicted by the half-finished protective act. Her covered frilled maid apron and clearly human adult proportions remain readable. Both arms, hands, and short natural human nails are ordinary human anatomy; only compact cat ears emerge through the hairline with millimeter-scale transitional fur at their organic roots. No tail is present. Her face, both working hands, the customer hand, the open sleeve, and the steaming cup share one tight focal plane. Warm practical light bounces across her face, cup steam, creased apron, and counter; natural skin texture, loose hair, contact shadows, and gentle background focus falloff. The close distance feels observed rather than displayed. Nonsexual everyday comedy, no glamour pose.
